title: devgate.spec-coherence.policy/v1 central policy bundle
description: Central minimum policy. Resolves from control-plane trust roots; repository overlay may strengthen only; anti-rollback applies (coh-pol-01, coh-pol-02).

bundle_epoch.description: This bundle's self-declared ordinal. Compared against the context-bound policy_binding.min_bundle_epoch floor at run time (design.md round-15).

min_bundle_epoch.description: Anti-rollback floor: bundles with epoch below this are rejected unless grandfathered.

required_assertions.description: Assertion IDs central policy requires on every evaluated repo.

assertion_severity_floor.description: Central severity floors; a repository cannot lower severity below this.

advisory_escalation.description: What exceeding stages.max_advisory_age_days does (coh-pol-03). Required whenever `stages` is declared — a bundle naming a dwell limit with no consequence for exceeding it is incomplete configuration (design.md round-16).

on_expiry.description: Closed enum, one value today: expiring advisory shelter is removed and the violation BLOCKS at enforcing stages. Widened deliberately, not by guess.

renewal.description: What may extend an advisory. A renewal is an ordinary scoped expiring exception; this only bounds what an approving authority may grant.

enforced_core_classes.description: Evaluator IDs whose baseline shelter ends at Stage 3 (enforced-core); absent means the Q2-freeze default (design.md round-14).
